text: 香港证监会市场监察部执行董事梁仲贤先生表示：“结算周期过渡至T+1乃维持香港作为国际金融中心的竞争力，以及确保与全球市场发展接轨的重要一步。我们欢迎香港交易所发表谘询总结，及采取以市场准备情况为依据的实施方式。本会呼吁业界参与者及早展开准备工作，评估有关转变对其系统、流程及营运安排的影响，并与交易对手及服务供应商紧密合作，以确保过渡工作顺利有序。”（香港证监会）
text_en: Mr. Leung Chung-yin, Executive Director of the Market Supervision Department of the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong, said: "The transition of the settlement cycle to T+1 is an important step in maintaining Hong Kong's competitiveness as an international financial center and ensuring alignment with global market developments. We welcome the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's publication of the consultation conclusions and its adoption of an implementation approach based on market readiness. The Commission calls on industry participants to begin preparatory work as early as possible, assess the impact of the change on their systems, processes and operational arrangements, and work closely with counterparties and service providers to ensure a smooth and orderly transition." (Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong)
